decisions.reason: The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the About page's prize copy to the new Small and Big Block parameters; no additional state change or removal is required.
The existing message-158 MODIFY already updates the Mission page's prize-pool copy to the revised winner counts and draw intervals.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the Big Block change to one winner, a $10,000 pool per draw, and a draw every 10,000 sales.
The existing message-158 MODIFY fully captures the Small Block change to one winner, a $500 pool per draw, and a draw every 100 sales.
Changing prize counts and draw intervals does not alter the flat royalty, founder share, ticket-generation rule, or royalty destinations.
Tickets remain separate Small and Big Block entries that reset after their applicable draw; the revised draw frequency does not change these relative lifecycle rules.
The source explicitly preserves the net giveaway amount and does not change mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, or prize-pool destinations.
The revised prize cadence does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or awarded commission and ticket types.
The source does not change which NFT state transfers on resale or the treatment of active and expired prize tickets.
Both Small and Big Block ticket counters remain required; changing prize amounts and draw intervals does not alter the metadata fields represented by this Requirement.
The source changes prize quantities and cadence but leaves ticket-weighted eligibility, Chainlink VRF randomness, and on-chain winner selection unchanged.
The prize-parameter change has no effect on the fiat provider, conversion path, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
